benefits.name: Hilton Resort Credit
benefits.description: Semi-annual statement credit for eligible purchases made directly with participating Hilton Resorts.
benefits.terms: Up to $200 per half-year period ($400/year total): Jan-Jun and Jul-Dec. Direct bookings at participating Hilton Resorts only. No enrollment required.

benefits.name: Flight Credit
benefits.description: Quarterly statement credit for flight purchases made directly with airlines or via American Express Travel.
benefits.terms: Up to $50 per quarter ($200/year total). Covers airfare itself, not just incidental fees. Unused quarterly amounts do not roll over.

benefits.name: Waldorf Astoria & Conrad Credit
benefits.description: Statement credit for qualifying charges at participating Waldorf Astoria Hotels & Resorts and Conrad Hotels & Resorts properties.
benefits.terms: Requires a minimum 2-night prepaid stay. Applies per qualifying booking rather than on a fixed renewal cycle.

benefits.name: CLEAR Plus Credit
benefits.description: Statement credit covering a CLEAR Plus auto-renewing membership for expedited airport security.
benefits.terms: Up to $219 per calendar year. Enrollment required. Auto-renewing membership only.

benefits.name: Annual Free Night Award
benefits.description: One Free Night Reward at a hotel or resort in the Hilton portfolio each year upon card renewal, plus additional Free Night Rewards after reaching annual spending thresholds.
benefits.terms: One Free Night Award granted on renewal each card membership year. Additional Free Night Awards earned after $30,000 and $60,000 in calendar-year eligible purchases.

benefits.name: Hilton Honors Diamond Status
benefits.description: Complimentary Hilton Honors Diamond status, including room upgrades, executive lounge access, food & beverage credits, and 5th night free on award stays.
benefits.terms: Enrollment is automatic/complimentary via linking a Hilton Honors account.

benefits.name: National Car Rental Emerald Club Executive Status
benefits.description: Complimentary Emerald Club Executive status with National Car Rental, including Executive Area access.
benefits.terms: Enrollment required through the American Express account.

benefits.name: Cell Phone Protection
benefits.description: Coverage for damage or theft of a cell phone when the monthly wireless bill is paid with the card.
benefits.terms: Up to $800 per claim, up to $1,600 per 12-month period. Subject to a deductible.

benefits.name: Premium Global Assist Hotline
benefits.description: 24/7 emergency medical, legal, and travel assistance for cardholders traveling 100+ miles from home.

earningRates.terms: Purchases made directly with hotels and resorts in the Hilton portfolio.
Flights booked directly with airlines, car rentals booked directly with select car rental companies, and U.S. restaurants.
